page.layout: One printed page: the e-rara digitiser's cover sheet with logo, title block, rules and licence notices. No body text of the book.
page.notes: The page is the digitiser's cover sheet, not printed book text. Its e-rara logo, Visual Library logo, rules, and the multilingual usage notices (German, English, French, Italian) are the digitiser's own matter and are not transcribed. Only the title block (title, author, place and date of printing, holding library, persistent link) is given above, as a title page transcription. The book's own title page is not on this scan.
